title: Estimate ending inventory using the average cost and conventional retail methods

items.concept: Initial recognition of purchases/freight/returns; average cost retail inventory schedule; period-end COGS and inventory adjusting entries; comparison to conventional retail
Average cost retail inventory schedule and period-end inventory/COGS entries (all numbers changed)
Conventional retail method with freight, returns, abnormal casualty, sales returns, employee discounts, and normal spoilage; casualty loss JE; LCM approximation and presentation
Distinguish average cost retail vs conventional retail treatment of net markdowns in the cost-to-retail ratio
Conventional retail approximates lower of average cost or market
